title: An instance of a local `let poly_` function leaves its region: segmentation fault
summary: With `-extension layout_poly_alpha`, an instance of a local `let poly_` function that captures a stack block is a closure allocated on the local stack, but the type checker gives it the mode of the function. Here `instance ()` returns `pick` out of its region, a later stack allocation overwrites it, and the call through it ends with a segmentation fault.

expected.text: The compiler refuses the program: `This value is local but is expected to be local to the parent region or global`.

actual.text: The program ends with a segmentation fault (bytecode prints `result 10`).

cause: `typing/typecore.ml`, the case `Pexp_ident`: an instance of a `let poly_` function (`Texp_apply_layout`) is checked at the mode of the name, while the translation allocates its closure in the region open where the name is written.

fix.text: Checks the instance a second time at the mode of the name with "regional" replaced by "local". Builds; the compiler then refuses `test.ml`; testsuite unchanged.
